input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include authentication, userinfo, vehicle. Core business data revolves around AbstractAuditableEntity, AbstractPersistableEntity, User, Vehicle. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to manage authentication operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
